notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-c47dd2ce9a62, DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2020.02023, PMCID PMC7469538. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the Naples shallow-water hydrothermal vent study.
source_text: Paired-end reads were merged using USEARCH after q25 trimming of the ends. Sequences less than 380 bp and those containing an ambiguous base were removed. Reads were clustered into de novo operational taxonomic units (OTUs) using Swarm with an aggregation distance equal to 3. Chimeras were then removed with VSEARCH. OTUs were taxonomically assigned by BLASTn+ using the Silva release 132 reference database with a minimum coverage of 60%. The nematode taxon was reported as Oncholaimus sp.
